description: Append Markdown text to an existing text note (e.g. to maintain a running log). Does not act on notes in the trash.

noteId.description: The note's UUID, as returned by list_notes / search_notes / create_note.

open.description: Bring the note to the foreground after appending.

separator.description: Separator inserted before the new text when the note is non-empty. Defaults to a blank line.

name: append_to_note

ref.description: The exact pinmark-asset:/// address in content; keep it intact when editing.

content.description: Verbatim Markdown. Base every edit on this field.

nextOffset.description: Pass as imageOffset to read further tiles; null after the last tile.

images.description: Tile metadata; the pixels are in the image content blocks, in this order.

error.description: Set when this tile could not be encoded; the image block is then omitted.

index.description: Stable tile index within the whole image.

region.description: Pixel range of this tile on the original image; adjacent tiles overlap.

isDeleted.description: Whether the note is in the trash.

isPinned.description: Whether the note is pinned to the desktop (its desktop window is open).

visibleText.description: Readable text with markup removed. For reading only; never write it back.

title: Append to note
